spec.title: Retro Arcade Styled "RVASDUG Meetup" Title
spec.content:
# Retro Arcade Styled "RVASDUG Meetup" Title

## Overview

Transform the existing React hello world application into a retro 8-bit arcade-themed experience with a prominent blinking title displaying "RVASDUG Meetup". The implementation should evoke classic arcade games from the 1980s with pixel-style fonts, vibrant colors, and period-appropriate visual effects applied to the entire page.

## Requirements

* Replace the current application title with "RVASDUG Meetup" styled in an 8-bit pixel font
* Implement a blinking text animation on the title that cycles at approximately 1-second intervals
* Apply an 8-bit pixel font family throughout the entire application (e.g., Press Start 2P, VT323, or similar web-safe retro font)
* Style the page background with a dark color scheme reminiscent of arcade cabinets (black or dark blue base)
* Add vibrant accent colors typical of 8-bit arcade games (neon cyan, magenta, yellow, bright green)
* Include optional scanline overlay effect across the page to simulate CRT monitor appearance
* Ensure the title is prominently displayed and centered on the page
* Maintain responsive design so the retro styling works on mobile and desktop viewports
* Load retro fonts via CDN (Google Fonts or similar) to avoid local font file management
* Use CSS animations (not JavaScript timers) for the blinking effect to ensure smooth performance

## Acceptance Criteria

* The title "RVASDUG Meetup" is displayed in a pixel-style 8-bit font
* The title blinks on and off at a regular interval (approximately 1 second per cycle)
* The entire page background is styled with a dark retro arcade color scheme
* All text on the page uses 8-bit style fonts
* The page includes at least two vibrant neon-style accent colors in the design
* The retro font loads successfully from an external CDN without errors
* The blinking animation runs smoothly without flickering or performance issues
* The page remains readable and functional on screen widths from 320px to 1920px
* No existing functionality of the React application is broken by the styling changes
* The visual aesthetic clearly evokes 1980s arcade games without requiring modern design patterns

## Constraints

* Must use only CSS and existing React capabilities; no additional JavaScript animation libraries
* Retro fonts must be loaded via CDN (Google Fonts recommended) rather than local files
* Styling should be done via CSS modules, styled-components, or standard CSS files depending on project structure
* The implementation should not require installation of additional npm packages beyond what may already exist in the project
* Browser compatibility should target modern evergreen browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) from the last 2 years
* Animation performance must not cause layout shifts or excessive repaints
* Keep the existing React component structure intact; apply styling changes only

Goals:
- Transform the React hello world app into a retro 8-bit arcade themed experience
- Display 'RVASDUG Meetup' as the main title with retro styling and blinking animation
- Apply consistent 8-bit arcade aesthetic across the entire application

Tasks:
- Import retro 8-bit font from Google Fonts CDN (Press Start 2P or VT323)
- Replace current application title with 'RVASDUG Meetup'
- Style title with pixel font, centering, and prominent display
- Implement CSS keyframe animation for title blinking effect (~1 second cycle)
- Apply dark arcade-themed background (black or dark blue)
- Add vibrant neon accent colors (cyan, magenta, yellow, bright green)
- Apply 8-bit font family globally to all text elements
- Implement optional CRT scanline overlay effect
- Ensure responsive layout for 320px-1920px viewport widths
- Test animation performance and cross-browser compatibility

prReview.summary: Excellent retro arcade implementation that meets all functional spec requirements with comprehensive test coverage (88 tests). The styling successfully creates an authentic 1980s arcade aesthetic with proper fonts, animations, and responsive design. However, the PR has critical security vulnerabilities that must be addressed before merging: 6 HIGH severity tabnabbing vulnerabilities and potentially problematic mobile font sizing.

comments.comment: CRITICAL SECURITY: External link with target='_blank' missing rel='noopener noreferrer'. This enables tabnabbing attacks where the opened page can access window.opener and redirect the parent page. Add rel='noopener noreferrer' to this and all other external links (also at lines 50, 65, 77, 89, 101).

ACCESSIBILITY CONCERN: Base font size of 8px at the 768px breakpoint may be too small for readability, especially for pixel fonts like Press Start 2P. Consider using a minimum of 10px to ensure text remains legible on mobile devices.

SECURITY (Medium): Google Fonts loaded without Subresource Integrity (SRI) hashes. While this is a common practice, adding SRI hashes would provide additional security against CDN compromise. Consider using tools like srihash.org to generate hashes.

SECURITY (Low): No Content Security Policy (CSP) defined. While not critical for this project, adding a CSP meta tag or header would provide defense-in-depth against XSS attacks and unauthorized resource loading.
EXCELLENT: Blinking animation implementation is clean, CSS-only, and meets spec requirements perfectly. The step-end timing function creates the sharp arcade-style blink effect.
EXCELLENT: Color scheme implementation is spot-on for retro arcade aesthetics. All required neon colors (cyan, magenta, yellow, green) are present with appropriate glow effects.
NICE TOUCH: The scanline overlay effect with pseudo-element is a clever implementation that adds authenticity without affecting performance or interactivity.
EXCELLENT: Comprehensive test coverage with 88 tests across all acceptance criteria. Well-structured test suites that will catch regressions.

recommendedActions: CRITICAL: Add rel='noopener noreferrer' to all 6 external links with target='_blank' in src/App.jsx (lines 44, 50, 65, 77, 89, 101) to fix tabnabbing vulnerabilities
IMPORTANT: Increase minimum mobile font size from 8px to at least 10px in the 768px breakpoint for better readability
Re-run security review after fixes to ensure it passes at HIGH threshold
Consider adding SRI hashes to Google Fonts links for enhanced security
Consider adding a basic Content Security Policy meta tag
Test the application on actual mobile devices to verify 8px font size readability before potentially adjusting
Run all 88 tests to ensure implementation passes: npm test -- --run --maxWorkers=1
